buildCommand: if [ -n "$GMAPS_BROWSER_KEY" ]; then grep -q __GMAPS_KEY__ config.js && sed -i "s|__GMAPS_KEY__|$GMAPS_BROWSER_KEY|" config.js || { echo 'config.js placeholder drifted — refusing to ship keyless by accident'; exit 1; }; else echo 'GMAPS_BROWSER_KEY not set — deploying keyless (grid map backdrop)'; fi
